    Clubs and independent groups

    Run by students

    • ASA TPC

      • Instagram @asa.tpc (opens in a new tab)

    • Thammasat English Debate Club

      A club that debates current world issues and gives students a space to exchange views in English.

      • Instagram @tu.englishdebate (opens in a new tab)

    • TPC Allstar

      A basketball and volleyball club for Thammasat Tha Prachan students, giving people somewhere to play together, for their health and to get to know each other.

      • Instagram @tpcbasket (opens in a new tab)

    • TPC Dance

      A dance club, and a space for Thammasat Tha Prachan students who love to dance.

      • Instagram @firebrick.tpcdance (opens in a new tab)

    • TPC Film Club

      An independent group for people who love film: watching together, discussing them critically, and making and shooting their own.

      • Instagram @tpc.filmclub (opens in a new tab)

    • TPC Music

      A music club, open to any Thammasat Tha Prachan student who loves music.

      • Instagram @tpc.music (opens in a new tab)

    • TU Documentary

      An independent group making documentaries as photography, video and writing, on the view that those tell a story best.

      • Instagram @tudocumentary (opens in a new tab)

    • TUHost

      A club for hosting and compering, and for making creative media at Thammasat Tha Prachan.

      • Instagram @tuhost_official (opens in a new tab)

    • TUTPC.FC

      An independent group for Thammasat Tha Prachan students who play football and futsal, and want people to play with.

      • Instagram @tutpc.fc (opens in a new tab)
